title: 30A Shady Palms
meta_description: Welcome to 30A Shady Palms! 6BR single-level retreat with private heated pool, golf cart, bikes \& boat-friendly access near the beach!
description_expanded:
PRIVATE HEATED POOL
SINGLE LEVEL LIVING
6-SEATER GOLF CART
BOAT-FRIENDLY

ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to 30A Shady Palms, located in the heart of Seagrove Beach. This 6 bedroom, 4.5 bath, coastal retreat with private pool and backyard, will blow you away! This sprawling single level home is ideal for multi-generational families. The open concept living area and round dining table with extra seating at the kitchen island, make this the perfect spot for family game nights or feasts. You can also hang out on the most comfortable sectional sofa that's just inviting you to chill. The backyard oasis is where you'll be spending most your time when you're not at the beautiful beaches. The pool area has plenty of seating and lounge chairs to soak up all the rays! There's even a porch with comfy seating to relax or to take that much deserved nap under the fan. 30a Shady Palms is also a perfect home for the boaters looking to explore great fishing both in Choctawhatchee Bay or head offshore in the Gulf of Mexico for an experience that will last a life time.

ABOUT THE AREA: 30A Shady Palms is centrally located on 30A in the quaint community of Seagrove. Infused with the charm of family-owned establishments, Seagrove stands out as a quintessential beach getaway. Seagrove's enchanting blend of lush oak trees, magnolias, and a laid-back yet luxurious atmosphere has secured its place as a beloved destination for seasoned South Walton visitors. The vibrant landscape harmonizes seamlessly with a diverse array of boutiques, casual cafes, and an overall uplifting ambiance. A sojourn in Seagrove promises adventure. The locale's proximity beckons exploration of Deer Lake State Park and Eastern Lake, with biking along the Timpoochee Trail emerging as the favored means of traversing the area. Anticipate the convenience of a new Regional Beach Access in 2021, enhancing the ease of sinking your toes into the sugar-white sand. For a taste of tradition, dining at Café Thirty-A is a must. As one of the pioneers along Highway 30A, this South Walton gem has left an indelible mark. Venture slightly west on Highway 395, and Seagrove Village Market awaits, a timeless haven for delectable shrimp po boys and a nostalgic journey dating back to 1949.
To the east, overlooking the aptly named Eastern Lake, Old Florida Fish House beckons for lunch or dinner. Renowned for its sushi and lively musical ambiance, it's an experience not to be missed. Amidst shady retreats, sun-soaked beaches, and a contagious sense of joy, Seagrove stands out as the quintessential beach community, offering families the classic Florida vacation vibe they crave.

BEACH ACCESS: The closest beach is San Juan Beach Access (only accessible by foot, bike or golf cart). When you exit your home follow your road until the stop sign, cross 30A and the access path is straight ahead. Santa Clara Beach Access is the closest that has Lifeguards, Restrooms, Plenty of Parking and is Wheelchair Accessible!

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 16
• Bedroom 1 -- King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- King, ensuite
• Bedroom 3 -- Queen (Jack n Jill shared bath)
• Bedroom 4 -- Queen (Jack n Jill shared bath)
• Bedroom 5 -- Bunk room (2 Twin/Twin - sleeps 4)
• Bedroom 6 -- Bunk room (Queen over King - sleeps 4)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Private Pool and fenced in backyard (heated upon request)
• Covered deck with outdoor seating
• Outdoor shower
• Grill - Propane
• 4 Bicycles
• Washer \& Dryer
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.

Parking Details:
- This property has 2 parking spaces with no overflow available.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
